Definition: a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress)
BiblicalUsage: 1) stroke, plague, disease, mark, plague spot; 1a) stroke, wound; 1b) stroke (metaphorical of disease); 1c) mark (of leprosy)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
